title: docs(types,fields): `rows` / `options[].description` docblocks stop asserting a refusal the spec no longer performs
body:
Fixes #7635

Five shipped doc comments assert that `@objectstack/spec` REFUSES `rows` and `options[].description` BY NAME. It **declares** both. This corrects the prose; it changes no runtime behaviour, type surface or export.

## The premise the card was parked on is dead — re-derived, not inherited

The card calls itself 「bump-blocked」 and says 「The repo is still on 17.2.0 — so nothing is broken *today*」. Measured on `origin/main`'s `pnpm-lock.yaml`: there is exactly **one** `@objectstack/spec` package entry and it is **17.4.0**; every one of the 29 declared ranges resolves to it. The installed artifact agrees (`node_modules/@objectstack/spec/package.json` = 17.4.0). The bump landed and went past the version the card names, so the false comments are false on `main`, now.

⚠️ One correction to the dispatch's own reading: the histogram `24x17.0.0, 2x17.1.0, 1x17.2.0, 1x17.3.0, 7x17.4.0` is the **specifier-range** histogram (what `package.json` files ask for), not resolved versions. No `@objectstack/spec` resolves below 17.4.0. The conclusion is unchanged and strictly stronger.

## What the contract actually holds (measured against installed 17.4.0, not the changelog)

| | measured |
|---|---|
| `SelectOptionSchema` keys | `color, default, description, label, value, visibleWhen` — six, **including `description`** |
| option `description` | ACCEPTED as a string; empty string valid; non-string answers `invalid_type` |
| field whose `options` carry it | parses whole |
| `rows` on textarea/markdown/html/richtext | ACCEPTED, integer `>= 1` (`0` answers `too_small`, `1.5` answers `invalid_type: expected int`) |
| `rows` on `text` / `number` | refused — but by a **cross-field refinement** naming the key, ⛔ NOT `unrecognized_keys` |
| `icon` / `disabled` on an option | still refused BY NAME — the live half |
| `toolbar` / `preview` / `minHeight` / `maxHeight` | still refused BY NAME — the card's fence **holds** |

The type-gating nuance is load-bearing and the old prose could not express it: "declared" does not mean "declared everywhere", and the refusal for the wrong field type arrives through a different channel than the one the old comments named.

## The census — the card's "three comments" is not right

Re-derived from PRs #7510 / #7520 rather than trusted:

- **#7510** rewrote **three** docblocks, all in `packages/types/src/field-types.ts` (`MarkdownFieldMetadata.rows`, `HtmlFieldMetadata.rows`, `SelectOptionMetadata.description`) plus the `LookupField.optionDescription.test.tsx` header. **All four are false today.**
- **#7520** rewrote **one** comment, in `packages/app-shell/src/views/DashboardView.tsx` — about `title`, not about either of this card's keys. ⛔ I did not touch it, for two measured reasons: `DashboardSchema` **still** refuses root `title` by name at 17.4.0 (so the claim is true), and #7520's text no longer exists anyway — objectui#7509 replaced it wholesale when it retired the legacy `title` read.

⇒ the real count is **four** false sites from those two PRs, not three, and the third PR-#7520 site is **not** one of them. Two further sites in the same family were falsified by the repair itself and are fixed here: the `SelectOptionMetadata` interface docblock (which listed `description` among the by-name refusals) and the `RichtextFieldMetadata` cross-reference registered on the card by comment `5576403316`. Plus `packages/types/src/select-option.ts`, named by the pin's own header.

## ⭐ A gate DOES read these sites — the card's framing is out of date

The card says 「Nothing goes red」 and blames `check:spec-symbols`. That specific claim is **correct** — I ran it, it is green, and its member rule passes precisely because these citations now name keys the symbol *does* declare.

But `check:installed-pin-claims` (`scripts/check-installed-spec-pin-claims.mjs`, objectui#8924) landed **after this card was filed** and it reads two of these very sites — it had them ledgered as known-stale debt, with reasons written in anticipation of this repair (*"re-parse the schema before moving the number"*). Repairing the prose made it go **red**, by design:

```
FAIL LEDGER is stale: packages/fields/src/widgets/LookupField.optionDescription.test.tsx
  no longer carries a drifting @objectstack/spec 17.2.0 claim.
  Delete the entry in the same change that repaired the site.
FAIL LEDGER is stale: packages/types/src/field-types.ts ...
```

Both entries are deleted here, as that gate's both-direction ratchet requires. Taking Zone 3's *"if a comment can be replaced by something a gate CAN read, that is better than better prose"* literally, the two repaired claims are written as **single-line** claims about the installed pin, which is the shape the gate recognises. They therefore moved out of the ledger and into the checked population — `23 -> 25 at the pin`, `52 -> 50 ledger entries`, `stale 45 -> 43`. They now go red at the next bump instead of quietly lying. The other three sit on facts no instrument reads, and say so rather than reading as live (AGENTS.md #9).

## ⭐ An unreleased changeset would have shipped the same falsehood

`check:changeset-claims` flagged that `.changeset/7014-select-option-spec-claim-correction.md` — PR #7510's own changeset, still **pending** — names a file this change edits. Reading the paragraph as that gate asks: its dated 17.2.0 measurements are fine, but its present-tense guidance is now false and harmful — it tells authors that writing `description` on an option *"makes `PUT /api/v1/meta/object/:name` fail the **whole field** with a 422"*, and that the comments *"now say these are objectui-side read-model extensions that must never reach authored object metadata"*.

That body publishes **verbatim into the CHANGELOG at the next release** — the same release as this change's own entry, which says the opposite. Corrected in place, frontmatter untouched, per the precedent that gate names; `check:changeset-overwrite` records the deliberate modification (report-only, its case 2). This is the only site where the defect would have escaped the repo.

## Gates

Hand-derived from this repo's `package.json` and `.github/workflows/` — `dispatch-gates.mjs` **refuses** for objectui paths by design (it reads the objectstack tree), as the dispatch predicted. Exit codes captured to a file before reading, never through a pipe.

| gate | exit | verdict line |
|---|---|---|
| `check:installed-pin-claims` | 0 | `80 recognised claim site(s) - 25 at the pin, 50 ledger entr(ies)` |
| `check:spec-symbols` | 0 | `nothing cites a key its spec symbol does not declare` |
| `check:changeset-presence` | 0 | `4 source file(s) of 2 released package(s) ... declares 1 changeset(s)` |
| `check:changeset-claims` | 0 | report-only; its one finding is answered above |
| `check:changeset-overwrite` | 0 | records the deliberate #7014 correction (report-only) |
| `check:control-bytes` | 0 | `scanned 7739 tracked text file(s)` |
| `check:new-line-citations` | 0 | `0 new citation(s)` |
| `check:comment-mask-corpus` | 0 | 1 pre-existing disagreement, within the ceiling objectui#7882 holds open — not from this diff |
| tests | 0 | `Test Files 193 passed (193) / Tests 4561 passed (4561)` |
| `type-check` (`types`, `fields`) | 0 | both `Done` |

Tests cover `packages/types/`, the `LookupField` site, and `scripts/__tests__/check-installed-spec-pin-claims.test.ts` — owed separately because this diff edits that gate script. Run from the repo **root** (`pnpm exec vitest run <paths>`); the `pnpm --filter PKG exec vitest` form is refused by the #3378 guard and is a false green. Heavy runs went through the shared verify lock. `type-check` first failed with `TS2307` on an unbuilt dependency closure — built `@object-ui/fields^...` / `@object-ui/types^...`, then both passed.

Verified the repair reaches the **published** surface: after `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types run build`, `dist/field-types.d.ts` carries the corrected sentence and no `dist/*.d.ts` still says `REFUSES \`rows\` BY NAME`. The two surviving `NOT a spec key` strings in `dist/select-option.d.ts` are the `icon` / `disabled` docblocks, which I measured as genuinely still refused.

## Acceptance notes

- ⛔ `packages/types/src/data-display.ts` — out of surface (batch sibling objectui#9256). Not reached; no comment repair led there.
- ⛔ No runtime, type-surface or export change. Every assertion in the repaired files passes unchanged before and after — which is the point: nothing mechanical was watching these sentences, and that is why they rotted.
- `.changeset/` was in surface because published bytes move: docblocks under `packages/types/src` ship in `dist/*.d.ts`.
- Out-of-scope findings (for the seat to file) are enumerated in the `os-dev-report` comment on #7635.
